title: Molecular insight into binding behavior of Diosgenin with DNA, HIF-1alpha oxidoreductase and NF-kB p50: Molecular docking and MD simulation studies.
authors: Chaudhary, Priyanka Singh; Badruddeen; Shukla, Karuna S; Iqbal, Muzaffar; Verma, Anil; Akhtar, Juber; Ahmad, Mohammad; Khan, Mohammad Irfan
one_liner_zh: 该文通过分子对接和MD模拟研究薯蓣皂苷元与DNA、HIF-1α氧化还原酶及NF-kB p50的结合行为，涉及蛋白-DNA互作但非TF-DNA特异性结合机制，方法为物理模拟，可借鉴但深度有限。
abstract: INTRODUCTION: Diosgenin is an active constituent found in 'Fenugreek', also commonly known as 'Methi'. Saponin dioscin, which is taken from a variety of plants, including Trigonella, Dioscorea, Smilax, and Costus species, is the source of this drug. In this study, we have tried to prove diosgenin as potent anticancer agents by inhibiting HIF-1alpha oxidoreductases, NF-kB p50, and DNA transcription. METHODS: In this study, we conducted in silico study mainly molecular dynamics, molecular docking of diosgenin with DNA, HIF-1alpha oxidoreductases, and NF-kB p50. RESULTS: The diosgenin structure was optimised and following optimization, the diosgenin's molecule energy, dipole moment, and polarisability are -34816.60436965 eV, 2.527945 Debye and 274.875447 a. u., respectively. The binding affinity of diosgenin-DNA, diosgenin-oxidoreductases and diosgenin-NF-kB p50 were found to be -144.42 kcal/mol, -9.49 kcal/mol, and -8.69 kcal/mol, respectively. CONCLUSION: Oxidoreductase enzymes are crucial in healthy and cancerous cells for converting molecular oxygen into hydrogen peroxide, superoxide, singlet oxygen, and oxygen-free radicals. Similarly, another inducible transcription factor for genes related to adhesion, growth, differentiation, survival, and inflammation is nuclear factor-kB. DNA transcription is one of the major ways in which cancerous cells tend to grow. Therefore, it may be found that anticancer activity is achieved due to inhibition of HIF-1alpha oxidoreductases, NF-kB p50, and DNA transcription restriction.
abstract_zh: 引言：薯蓣皂苷元（diosgenin）是葫芦巴（'Fenugreek'）中发现的活性成分，通常也称为'Methi'。这种药物来源于皂苷薯蓣皂苷（dioscin），取自多种植物，包括葫芦巴属（Trigonella）、薯蓣属（Dioscorea）、菝葜属（Smilax）和闭鞘姜属（Costus）物种。在本研究中，我们试图通过抑制HIF-1alpha氧化还原酶、NF-kB p50和DNA转录，证明薯蓣皂苷元是有效的抗癌剂。方法：在本研究中，我们进行了计算机模拟研究，主要包括分子动力学、薯蓣皂苷元与DNA、HIF-1alpha氧化还原酶和NF-kB p50的分子对接。结果：薯蓣皂苷元结构经过优化，优化后其分子能量、偶极矩和极化率分别为-34816.60436965 eV、2.527945 Debye和274.875447 a.u.。薯蓣皂苷元-DNA、薯蓣皂苷元-氧化还原酶和薯蓣皂苷元-NF-kB p50的结合亲和力分别为-144.42 kcal/mol、-9.49 kcal/mol和-8.69 kcal/mol。结论：氧化还原酶在健康细胞和癌细胞中将分子氧转化为过氧化氢、超氧化物、单线态氧和氧自由基方面至关重要。类似地，核因子-kB是与粘附、生长、分化、存活和炎症相关基因的另一种诱导型转录因子。DNA转录是癌细胞生长的主要途径之一。因此，可以发现抗癌活性是通过抑制HIF-1alpha氧化还原酶、NF-kB p50和限制DNA转录来实现的。
